passages.title: A Day Full of the Unexpected
passages.body: Last Saturday started as a normal day, but it was full of the unexpected. First, I overslept. By the time I woke up, it was already nine o'clock. I had planned to meet my friend at the station at nine. I jumped out of bed and got ready in a hurry. But when I got to the bus stop, the bus had already left. I had to wait for the next one. When I finally arrived at the station, my friend had gone home. I felt terrible. I had let her down. Then my phone rang. It was my friend. "Don't worry," she said. "I overslept too! I just got here." We both laughed. What a day!

passages.title: The Day the Aliens Came
passages.body: On the night of October 30, 1938, something strange happened in the US. A radio show announced that aliens from Mars had landed on Earth. The show said the aliens were burning towns and killing people. Many people who were listening did not know it was just a play. They thought it was real news. People ran into the streets in fear. Some packed their things and tried to leave the city. The roads were full of cars. By the time people learned the truth, many had become very frightened. The show was actually a famous April Fool's-style hoax. It taught everyone to be careful about what they hear.

passages.title: An Embarrassing Costume Party
passages.body: Last week, I was invited to a costume party. I was very excited. I spent a long time making a funny costume. On the day of the party, I put on my costume and went to my friend's house. But when I got there, I was shocked. Everyone was wearing normal clothes! No one else had worn a costume. I stood at the door in disbelief. My friends stared at me. I felt so embarrassed. Then my friend laughed and said, "April Fool! There is no costume party. We just wanted to fool you!" By the time I understood, everyone was laughing. In the end, I laughed too. It was an embarrassing but fun day.

passages.title: The History of April Fool's Day
passages.body: April Fool's Day is celebrated in many countries on April 1st. On this day, people play jokes on each other. The jokes are meant to be funny, not unkind. No one knows for sure how the day began. Some people think it started in France a long time ago. When the new year was moved to January 1st, some people did not know about the change. They still celebrated the new year on April 1st. Others began to fool them and call them "April fools". Today, people of all ages enjoy this day. Even newspapers and TV stations sometimes report funny fake stories. But by the end of the day, they tell everyone the truth.

passages.title: The Lost Backpack
passages.body: It was a busy workday. Tom was in a hurry as usual. He grabbed his backpack and ran to catch the bus. By the time he got to the office, he was tired. He sat down and reached for his backpack. But it was not there! He realized he had left it on the bus. Inside were his keys, his phone, and some important papers. Tom was worried. He called the bus company. A kind lady there told him that a worker had found his backpack. "Don't worry," she said. "It is safe here." Tom felt a great sense of relief. By the end of the day, he had got his backpack back. He learned to slow down and be more careful.

passages.title: Notice: April Fool's Day Fun
passages.body: GREENWOOD SCHOOL — APRIL FOOL'S DAY! On April 1st, we will have a fun day at school. Here are the rules. KIND JOKES ONLY: You may play jokes on your friends, but they must be kind and safe. Do not hurt or scare anyone. COSTUME TIME: At lunch, you may wear a funny costume if you like. There will be a prize for the best one. NO MEAN TRICKS: Jokes that make others feel bad are not allowed. TELL THE TRUTH: By the end of the day, tell your friends the truth about any joke. Let's make this a day full of laughter. Remember, the best jokes make everyone happy, not just the joker!
